retained_diagnostics.label: abba-write-1080p-02-adaptive
retained_diagnostics.observation: One regular host window had zero H.264 frames and no last frame scope. H.264 packet flow resumed on the same session and geometry. The 60 s viewer interval includes a 3.56 s presentation gap.
retained_diagnostics.handling: The initial analysis required a frame in every host window. Reanalysis kept the original complete run and counted the empty window. Its automatic retry is supplementary.

pipeline_observations.encoder_order: The sender awaited video credit before opening the new NVENC target. The target opened after the stall.
pipeline_observations.remaining_attribution: The precise location of delay in the forward delivery, receiver progress or reverse ACK path is unresolved.
